Description

The Home class represents the main game screen where the user interacts with their pet duck.

The LoadSaves class is responsible for creating the user interface that displays a list of saved game states (saved ducks) that the user can choose to load.

Represents the main menu screen of the DuckLyfe2 application.

The SettingsMenu class provides a user interface for configuring various settings in the game.
